primary_effort: Connect controlled forward force acceptance to a prompt second forward takeoff.
readiness_gate: Use Repeated Broad Jump only after actual records establish controlled forward stops at the chosen modest distance (two sets of two), organized vertical rebounds (2 × 3 with 4/4 transitions and 2/2 final holds), acceptable subsequent response and current readiness. Keep forward displacement modest; do not add an approach or longer jump. If evidence is absent, use the fully specified E3 hold replacement below; today then consolidates force acceptance while E4 supplies the familiar multi-joint rebound task.

explosive.name: Broad Jump to Stick
explosive.dose: **1 × 2 modest jumps. 20 s between jumps; 60 s before E2.**
explosive.job: Establish forward receiving control before linking forward jumps. Brisk two-foot takeoff, short controllable projection and a 2 s hold with hips over the base. Shorten distance for reaching, stepping or trunk collapse.

explosive.name: Ankle Pogo in Place
explosive.dose: **1 × 6 low jumps**, continuous. **90 s before E3.**
explosive.job: Prepare low-amplitude ankle return without tiring the receiving legs. Stay tall, knees soft and feet centered; settle the last contact. Reduce amplitude or stop for heavy contacts/knee pumping.

explosive.name: Repeated Broad Jump — two connected jumps
explosive.dose: **3 × 2 jumps = 6 landings / 3 forward rebound transitions. 120 s between sets and before E4.**
explosive.job: **Primary anchor:** accept modest forward landing momentum and redirect it into a prompt second forward takeoff. Use two short two-foot jumps with natural arm swing; do not gather, shuffle or chase distance. The second landing is a 2 s stop. Reduce each displacement for reaching feet far ahead, a deep collapse, uncontrolled travel or a delayed extra dip.

explosive.name: Repeated Vertical Jump — three connected jumps
explosive.dose: **2 × 3 jumps = 6 landings / 4 transitions. 120 s between sets and before E5.**
explosive.job: Retain the familiar bilateral elastic reference after the primary receiving-leg task. Use the same qualified moderate height, natural arm swing and continuous reversal; settle the third landing for 2 s. Lower amplitude or use the two-jump regression if the second transition deteriorates.

explosive.name: Lateral Bound — stick landing
explosive.dose: **1 × 2 receiving landings per leg = 4 bounds.** Alternate sides with **20 s between bounds; 90 s before E6.**
explosive.job: Preserve frontal-plane single-leg acceptance without simultaneously adding lateral rebound complexity. Use the previously controlled small distance and a 2 s stop over each leg. Reduce distance for pelvis drop, ankle rolling or a corrective hop.

explosive.name: Single-Leg Pogo in Place
explosive.dose: **1 × 4 low hops per leg = 8 hops. 60 s between legs; 90 s before Section 3.**
explosive.job: Preserve a small single-leg ankle rebound demand distinct from E3’s held lateral landings. Keep the pelvis above the foot and the knee softly aligned; settle the fourth hop. Reduce amplitude/use support for rolling or rhythm loss.

replacement_routes.description: E3 hold replacement: still 32 landings = 20 bilateral + 12 single-leg, 52 limb contacts, but 15 transitions instead of 18. E3 hold time: 6 × 5 s + 4 × 20 s + 120 s between sets + 120 s after = 350 s; listed connected route 375 s.

E4 two-jump regression: 30 total landings, 18 bilateral + 12 single-leg and 48 limb contacts. Transitions are 16 on the forward-rebound route or 13 with the E3 hold replacement. E4 time approximately 250 s versus 252 s.

next_intended_job: Class 7 may link a familiar lateral landing to a return bound only after actual receiving-leg control and recovery, while keeping forward complexity out of that new-task day.
